full_page.content:
1932, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 12 Cont. IN NOMINE JESU INCIPIT A.D. 1932 A.D.
Jan. 1 First Friday of month, of week, year 1/1/32 Disapointment - no Benedicition after Mass.
Jan. 3 Marg. Wilkinson - 19 - enrold for year last evening - tested this a.m. and found positive indications of tubercular bone and spinal maningitis, is enrolled perpetually this P.M.
Bernard Casey - 48 - suger-diab. - 7 children Joseph Sabourin - 62 - cataract .. fears operation - Has invalid son of 17 years - paralysis 15 years. Noreen Echlin - 28 - curviture of spine - fears operation. Mrs. Laur's Br. - dope .. now in jail Klockow - Fam. - Lutherine ... Cath.
Page 13 Jan. Sister Lucia of St. Jos's Dearborn - gall trouble & Cancer? 4 complaints - Eviction Henry Godderris - Hic-cough - sugar diabetis
Jan. 8 Mrs. Elizabeth Campbell - 49 - of Rochester, Mich. - had cancer on nose 2 yrs. ago - 20 yrs. ago had "matted hair" now has bad lump in throat Noreen Kingsley of 419 Parent Ave., Windsor - Enrolled a year ago as a perpetual member. Then in a dying condition from abscesses of the lungs - a positively hopeless case comes To-day in perfect health. Whereas doctors predicted when she turned for improvement, that she would never be able to do anything, she was teaching school six weeks after enrollment.
Jan. 10 Clara Hast - 59 - reports To-day "Spot on breast" she had feared as danger's when she enrolled on Nov. 12 - 15th vanished. Last Fri- day morning - no mark left.
Page 14 Blank Page
